column1: # Mario Tennis Fever (Switch 2, update v327680). Plays on the Mac: see README.md

# Camelot's engine on NintendoWare, SDK 20.5.17 built for the Switch 2 (Ounce), NVN2. main is a boot stub (nxboot): it decodes the game's code, one NRO, out of its data segment and loads it with nn::ro; the game's files are one archive, rom:/42.
# Packed from a dump folder with scripts/pack_dump.py. Shaders: BNSH in the archive's FSHA, VFXB and SARC members, and in the NRO (dm/gfx/tools/cra.py).

# The Switch 2 leaves games 9 GB of its 12 GB (Donkey Kong Bananza's figure, not measured here). The NPDM declares 32 MB of system resource, so virtual address memory is on; nninitStartup asks StandardAllocator for 16 GB of address space, and this SDK keeps its 1 GB node area, so a 16 GB alias region is too small.
# 256 MB in front + 20 GB alias region + 256 MB stack region + heap region
